content.title: Kuna Ranch Style
content.lead: Easy single-level living on a lot with space for the toys.
paragraphs: Four bedrooms on one level, a covered patio and room for an RV make this Kuna ranch a practical, comfortable fit.
Mature trees give the lot privacy and shade, and the open kitchen and living area keep the layout easy to live in.
